params.delegate: Address that MUST be the contract owner; it is set as both Ownable owner and LayerZero delegate.
params.endpoint: LayerZero endpoint address (forwarded to OApp init).
params.hubEid_: LayerZero endpoint ID of the Hub contract.
params.singleWithdrawGlobalVerifier_: Groth16 verifier for global single teleports.
params.singleWithdrawLocalVerifier_: Groth16 verifier for local single teleports.
params.token_: zERC20 token whose hash chain is reserved/minted against.
params.withdrawGlobalDecider_: Nova verifier for global teleport proofs.
params.withdrawLocalDecider_: Nova verifier for local teleport proofs.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

proveTransferRoot(bytes).details: Enforces consistency between (a) previously proved roots and (b) reserved hash chains, pausing on conflicts.

params.proof: Opaque calldata expected by `IRootDecider`, ABI-encoded as `uint256[32]`.

proxiableUUID().details: Implementation of the ERC1822 {proxiableUUID} function. This returns the storage slot used by the implementation. It is used to validate the implementation's compatibility when performing an upgrade. IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.

relayTransferRoot(bytes).details: Requires `latestProvedIndex` to have a non-zero root; excess msg.value is kept as the LZ native fee.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

reserveHashChain().details: Mirrors the first step of the private proof-of-burn lifecycle.

returns.hashChain: SHA-256 hash chain committed up to `index - 1`.
returns.index: Reserved transfer index copied from zERC20.

setDelegate(address).details: The delegate address should match the contract owner so that LayerZero callbacks and Ownable permissions stay aligned.

params._delegate: The address of the delegate to be set.

params._peer: The address of the peer to be associated with the corresponding endpoint.

params.newSingleWithdrawGlobalVerifier: Groth16 verifier for global single teleports.
params.newSingleWithdrawLocalVerifier: Groth16 verifier for local single teleports.

singleTeleport(bool,uint64,(uint64,bytes.details: Shares the same recipient/root validation pipeline as `teleport` but operates on Groth16 proofs.

params.gr: GeneralRecipient struct encoding chain id, recipient, tweak, and version byte.
params.isGlobal: Whether the proof references Hub-derived global roots.
params.proof: ABI-encoded Groth16 proof blob consumed by `IWithdrawVerifier`.

teleport(bool,uint64,(uint64,bytes32,byt.details: Proof enforces that `totalValue` strictly increases per recipient hash; `isGlobal` selects local/global root arrays.

params.gr: GeneralRecipient struct encoding chain id, recipient, tweak, and version byte.
params.isGlobal: Whether the proof references Hub-derived global roots.
params.proof: ABI-encoded Nova proof blob consumed by `IWithdrawDecider`.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

upgradeTo(address).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`, and subsequently execute the function call encoded in `data`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

activateEmergency().notice: Allows the owner to proactively pause the contract outside of proof conflicts.

deactivateEmergency().notice: Clears the emergency pause that is triggered when conflicting transfer roots are observed.

endpoint().notice: Retrieves the LayerZero endpoint associated with the OApp.

initialize(address,uint32,address,addres.notice: Initializes the verifier with the zERC20 token, Hub endpoint, LayerZero endpoint, and initial deciders.

isUpToDate().notice: Returns `true` when every proved root has been relayed to the Hub (`latestProvedIndex == latestRelayedIndex`).

peers(uint32).notice: Retrieves the peer (OApp) associated with a corresponding endpoint.

proveTransferRoot(bytes).notice: Verifies a Nova proof for a transfer-root transition and records the resulting root by index.

quoteRelay(bytes).notice: Quotes the native fee required to relay a TransferRoot payload to the Hub.

relayTransferRoot(bytes).notice: Sends the latest proved transfer root to the Hub over LayerZero so it can join the global aggregation tree.

reserveHashChain().notice: Snapshots the latest `(index, hashChain)` tuple from zERC20 so Nova proofs can reference stable inputs.

setDelegate(address).notice: Sets the delegate address for the OApp Core.

setPeer(uint32,bytes32).notice: Sets the peer address (OApp instance) for a corresponding endpoint.

setVerifiers(address,address,address,add.notice: Atomically rotates all decider/verifier addresses to keep proofs aligned with the latest deployments.

singleTeleport(bool,uint64,(uint64,bytes.notice: Executes the Groth16 teleport flow for lightweight single withdrawals.

teleport(bool,uint64,(uint64,bytes32,byt.notice: Executes the multi-note Nova teleport flow, minting the delta on zERC20.
